headline.text: Tramadol with lorazepam may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death

reported.text: The label describes concomitant use of tramadol with benzodiazepines such as lorazepam as potentially resulting in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.
The label reserves concomitant prescribing for patients with inadequate alternative options and describes limiting dosage and duration with follow-up for respiratory depression and sedation.
